title: A layout is a small React component

buildSteps.label: Core layouts
buildSteps.description: title, content, progressiveBuild, media, diagram, polls, and more come with the template: docs/implementation/layouts.md lists them and their fields.

buildSteps.label: Your own
buildSteps.description: The task panel of the last slides is this deck's own layout, in tutorial/layouts/TaskSlide/: about a hundred lines that read a slide's fields and draw them.

buildSteps.label: Registered by name
buildSteps.description: tutorial/layouts/index.js gives it the name task, which is what those slides write after "layout".
